assessments.reasoning: GNU's Licenses archive serves gpl-3.0.txt with the FSF copyright and edition heading. The three captures cover contiguous bytes 0–35149 and report the complete-file digest in the claim.
The Index's own docs/SCOPE.md at cdff8aeed68bf1f9c62d8c86159c7dc08b2d75d7 supplies the License row at bytes [533,639). The FSF text supplies each required instrument fact for that row.

challenge.method: Applied SCES-1.0 §§1, 3–4 and Protocol stage 7 at policy commit ab26f278422772f2d9e5d4dd016407d14372a710, supplied adopted bundle SHA-256 14da3f31f697ab828d4a4560f060dbe511861020db54bea7bc531e20ea0855ce. Tested whether §7 makes this an exception record and whether the application example makes “or later” part of the edition identity.
challenge.results: Section 7 governs permissions that may supplement the license. The heading and §0 fix the instrument at version 3. Section 14 makes later-version choice depend on the program's notice, and the closing application instructions present an example notice.

limitations: Active is the proposed Index lifecycle value. A particular project's grant, version election and modifications require its own notice.
